svg.title: P18 bound admissible region
svg.desc: What this figure shows: Every admissible point lies on or below the identity line; the sharp collapsed-fiber witness reaches the boundary. The plotted object is generated from 0 <= d_f-d_c <= rho(P)+rho(Q). How to read it: compare the labeled axes, curves, contours, matrix entries, bars, or markers exactly as defined in the atlas entry; the visible trend is the numerical realization of the stated equation or construction. Scientific status: Synthetic bound-domain visualization. Unless explicitly identified otherwise, this is not empirical consciousness data.
